brief.title: Discovery call — Driver dispatch & proof-of-delivery platform — 10 Feb 2026
business_goals: Right now dispatch is done manually by hub coordinators looking at a spreadsheet — we need the system to auto-assign the nearest available rider to each order.
The auto-assignment needs to consider both distance and current rider load — someone with three pending drops shouldn't get a fourth if there's a free rider two streets away.
Riders need a mobile app that shows their route for the day, and it must work with patchy network — a lot of our delivery zones have poor connectivity.
The app should queue updates offline and sync when signal comes back.
constraints: Last month we had a rider go completely off-route for two hours and nobody noticed until the customer called to complain, that shouldn't be able to happen again.
We need this live before the next big sale event, which is roughly ten weeks out, and the finance team has capped spend at 35 lakh for build plus first year of maps API costs.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
